Priya Patel: Quick heads-up — prepping a cost readout for Kestrel ahead of their renewal. Need token runway (30/60/90), current spend trend, and any enablement gaps. Sync Friday 3pm PT? Please drop numbers and links.

Liam Chen: I'll pull the token usage dump and run a 30/60 forecast. Which baseline window do we want — last 30d or last 90d? :thinking_face:

Noah Ruiz: baseline = last 30d. quick numbers: MTD spend = $12,420; avg daily tokens = 4,320,000; projected 30d burn w/o controls ≈ $15,600. With caching+quantization we estimate ~20–30% savings. I'll paste the CSV extract below.

Ivy Morgan: Onboarding status: playbook ~60% complete. Open items: schema mapping for embeddings + two enablement sessions with engineering still outstanding. Risk: if enablement lags, their usage spikes will outpace commit and trigger throttles/alerts.

BudgetBot: [Alert] Kestrel account usage reached 72% of their committed monthly tokens.

Priya Patel: thanks Noah. Can you paste the 30/60/90 numbers inline? Need to add to the exec slide. Also can we run a quick "what-if" with a token cap at 5M/day to show a control scenario?

Noah Ruiz: pasted numbers: 30d projection: $15,600; 60d rolling projection: $31,400; 90d: $48,000 (naive). With 25% optimization -> 30d = $11,700. With token cap @5M/day -> approx $13,800 / 30d. CSV export: https://redwood.app/internal/kestrel-usage.csv

Liam Chen: I'll prepare two options for the slide deck: (A) preserve UX and recommend commit increase; (B) cost-control plan (caching + token cap + quantization). Drafting a short appendix now.

Liam Chen: ```Recommended callouts for exec appendix:
- 30d baseline: $15.6k
- Optimization potential: 20-30% (~$3–4.5k)
- Control scenario (5M/day cap): ~$13.8k / 30d
- Risk: delayed enablement -> 10–15% higher burst costs
- Ask: consider a 10% bump to monthly commit OR adopt control plan to avoid throttles
```

Ivy Morgan: To unblock the remaining enablement work: @Liam can you share the embeddings schema mapping and a 10-15 prompt mock set? I can book the two sessions this week and align success criteria.

Priya Patel: Action items:
- @Noah paste final numbers into the slide by EOD Thu
- @Liam produce 2-slide appendix + embed-mapping link by EOD Thu
- @Ivy confirm sessions + success criteria and share invite
I'll run the Friday 3pm PT readout with AM + CS. :thumbsup:

BudgetBot: [Info] Scheduled alert: will escalate to owner if usage > 85% of commit in next 48h.
